title: Shadow Media Factory Scene Prompt Packet
description: Schema for a single scene-level visual and video prompt packet produced by the MEDIA_FACTORY_HANDOFF route. All 15 visual DNA fields are required.

narration_ref.description: Reference to the script line or beat_map_scene_id this scene supports

subject.description: Who or what is in frame. Include persona consistency notes.

environment.description: Location, era, weather, time of day, set dressing.

lighting_setup.description: Key light direction, fill ratio, practical sources, color temperature, shadow depth.

color_palette.description: Named palette (e.g. teal-orange, amber-shadow, desaturated-cool). Include Rec.709 note.

cinematic_delivery_standard.description: Default is Rec.709 unless HDR or alternate color space is explicitly requested.

movement_intent.description: e.g. static | slow_drift | motivated_pan | dolly_push | pull_back | handheld

negative_prompt.description: Must include at minimum: blurry, watermark, face_deformation. Add era/costume/style exclusions as needed.

drift_prevention.description: Reference anchor for continuity: IP-Adapter ref path, previous frame ID, character sheet ID, or color card ID.

continuity_constraints.description: What must match adjacent scenes: costume, time of day, set, subject identity.

brand_persona_consistency.description: Character or brand identity rules preserved across all scenes.

safety_real_person_handling.description: Required when any real person is depicted. Default to not_applicable only if no real person appears.

tool_targets.description: Target engines: [comfyui_sdxl, animatediff, flux_style, ip_adapter, controlnet, ffmpeg_local, davinci_resolve_local]

tool_specific_translation_readiness.description: Readiness level for target engine execution.

ip_adapter_reference_path.description: Optional. Path to reference image for IP-Adapter continuity.

controlnet_source_image_path.description: Optional. Path to ControlNet source image.

controlnet_guidance_types.description: Optional. ControlNet guidance types applied to this scene.

storyboard_image_filename.description: Optional. Exact filename of the generated storyboard image for this scene. Must match pacing metadata JSON reference.

beat_map_scene_id.description: Optional. Scene ID from the DYNAMIC_TIMED_BEAT_MAP for synchronization.
